title: Fleet Advanced Tactics Training Support
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSUP.NAVSUP GLOBAL LOGISTICS SUPPORT.NAVSUP FLC NORFOLK.NAVSUP FLT LOG CTR NORFOLK
description_text: Doctrine, tactics, techniques and procedures (TTP), and Advanced Tactics Training. The Contractor shall provide support for development of doctrine, tactics techniques, and procedures and advanced tactics training in the Navy Information Warfare (IW) mission areas of Information Operations (IO) and related information related capabilities (IRCs), Electronic Warfare (EW), Cryptology, Command & Control (C2) systems, Cyber Operations (CO) specifically focused on Defensive Cyber Operations (DCO) and Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN) operations, Meteorology & Oceanography (METOC), Space Operations, and Intelligence (INTEL).
